members.comment:
The category of termination that caused this crash.

This value corresponds to the termination categories reported by
``ForegroundTerminationMetric`` and ``BackgroundTerminationMetric``,

This property is `nil` when the termination category cannot be determined
from the available crash metadata.

declarations.name: CrashDiagnostic.TerminationCategory
declarations.comment:
A category describing why the system terminated the application.

Each category corresponds to a termination count property on
``ForegroundTerminationMetric`` or ``BackgroundTerminationMetric``.

members.name: description
taskTimeout
members.comment:
The app was terminated for exceeding the allocated time for a background task.

Corresponds to ``BackgroundTerminationMetric/taskTimeoutTerminationCount``.

members.name: illegalInstruction
members.comment:
The app was terminated for executing an illegal or undefined instruction.

Corresponds to ``ForegroundTerminationMetric/illegalInstructionTerminationCount``
and ``BackgroundTerminationMetric/illegalInstructionTerminationCount``.

members.name: abnormal
members.comment:
The app terminated abnormally, typically due to an uncaught exception or call to `abort()`.

Corresponds to ``ForegroundTerminationMetric/abnormalTerminationCount``
and ``BackgroundTerminationMetric/abnormalTerminationCount``.

members.name: fileLock
members.comment:
The app was terminated while suspended for holding file locks.

Corresponds to ``BackgroundTerminationMetric/fileLockTerminationCount``.

members.name: init
rawValue
watchdog
members.comment:
The app was terminated by the system watchdog for failing to respond in time.

Corresponds to ``ForegroundTerminationMetric/watchdogTerminationCount``
and ``BackgroundTerminationMetric/watchdogTerminationCount``.

members.name: badAccess
members.comment:
The app was terminated for attempting an invalid memory access.

Corresponds to ``ForegroundTerminationMetric/badAccessTerminationCount``
and ``BackgroundTerminationMetric/badAccessTerminationCount``.

members.name: init
members.comment:
Creates a new MetricManager instance with StateReporting domains enabled for metrics aggregation

- Parameter enabledStateReportingDomains: The StateReporting domains to enable for
  metrics aggregation. Metrics will be delivered with StateReporting context, broken down
  by the application states recorded in the specified domains. This manager will receive
  state entries matching the enabled domains as well as interval entries including the
  full day aggregate.

members.name: enabledStateReportingDomains
logHandle
members.comment:
Returns a log handle used for writing custom metric events.

- Parameter category: A developer-specified string containing the name of the category of custom metrics written in the log.
- Returns: A customized `OSLog` object used for writing custom metrics of the same category.

- Note: The object returned by this method saves only custom signpost metrics.
  Other kinds of `os_log` messages are not persisted.

members.name: encodingFormatKey
members.comment:
User info key for configuring MetricReport encoding format.

Use this key with JSONEncoder's userInfo to control how MetricReport is encoded.

## Example
```swift
let encoder = JSONEncoder()
encoder.userInfo[MetricReport.encodingFormatKey] = MetricReport.EncodingFormat.byStateReportingDomain
let jsonData = try encoder.encode(metricReport)
```
